pr.title: Fix BRC deadlock: block reviewer confirm with unresolved NACKs
pr.description:
Adds an unresolved-NACK guard to handle_confirmed() that prevents reviewers
from entering terminal CONFIRMED state while holding outstanding NACKs against
producers that haven't re-proposed. Fixes #1576.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new tests in test_peer_consensus_integration.py cover the guard rejection, the recovery path (re-propose + re-ACK + confirm), and the full #1576 multi-agent scenario
- Manual: verify existing BRC tests still pass with `pytest orchestrator/tests/`
